title: Stand-Up India Scheme: ey Facts
summary: Schemes — Stand-Up India Scheme: ey Facts

items:  Objective: Promote entrepreneurship among SC/ST and women.
 Focus: Provide loans to set up greenfield enterprises in manufacturing, services, or trading sectors.
o SC/ST or women entrepreneurs aged 18+.
 Tenure: Loan repayment period up to 7 years.
 Implementation: Managed by all Scheduled Commercial Banks.
 Additional Support: Handholding services, including guidance and mentoring.
 Goal: Encourage job creation and economic empowerment.
